To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combination of XML and reflection is a promising solution for building software components that can be easily moved across multiple platforms.
• XML is the best way to describe the structure of software components and the interfaces to those components.
• A component-based architecture is a good way to build software that is platform-independent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of software that can be used on many platforms.
the design of software systems that have a long useful life and are easy to port to new platforms.
the development of a component-based software engineering environment for building software systems from reusable components.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cross-platform development is the process of developing a software application or program so that it can be used on multiple platforms.
cross-platform development is a very important aspect of software engineering, and one that should be taken into consideration when developing software.
, the software industry needs to adopt a new approach to software engineering.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of component-based development, reflection and XML can produce software that lasts.
we can use the XML and reflection techniques to create a framework for building software that will run on any platform, and will be able to run in the future as platforms change and evolve.
the use of reflection and XML can make components portable across platforms and languages.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the software engineering community needs to embrace cross-platform software engineering as a new discipline.
it is possible to build components that are platform and language independent.
the use of middleware to link components and tools through reflection and XML can make a significant contribution to the longevity and portability of software.
